findings.claim: The observed window is the native score clock [0.0, 0.49] with 50 observed score nodes; the learning window is [0.0, 0.5] and recorded affinities were removed (equal score prior), so selection preference is the only available label and decoded final affinity is unobserved.

For landmark_00_local_dx the observed curve is non-monotone over the full support: it rises to a positive peak near t~0.10-0.11, falls to a negative trough near t~0.19, partially recovers, and ends near zero; the whole-window mean z is slightly negative (-0.18) while first and last node z are both positive, so the endpoint contrast is small relative to the interior excursion.

The landmark_00_local_dx curve has 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches, and the quadratic fit is not accepted (polynomial_accepted=false, relative_node_RMSE 0.78); the first-node rate z is strongly negative (-17.5) and the last-node rate z is strongly positive (+8.1), indicating a steep early decline and a late rise rather than a stationary target.

hypotheses.direction: no single monotone direction is supported; the observed contrast is early-positive to mid-negative with late return toward zero
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the same curve over the same support showing no sign changes, or a whole-window mean and endpoint contrast consistent with a stationary target, would falsify this candidate.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx (predicted endpoint world-A local x-displacement of landmark 00)
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score window [0.0, 0.49]; no extrapolation beyond observed nodes
hypotheses.statement: landmark_00_local_dx is a supported temporal coordinate candidate: its observed trajectory is a large interior excursion (positive early, negative mid-window, near-zero late) with strong per-node rate contrasts at both ends of the observed window.

limitations: Only one feature curve (landmark_00_local_dx) was read; the remaining 199 curve features were not inspected, so no comparative ranking across coordinates is claimed.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; only continuous curves are delivered.
No decoded final affinity or survival label is available in this input, so selection preference cannot be separated from descendant survival or measured final benefit.
The curve is a coordinate proxy in predicted endpoint world-A; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
The quadratic polynomial was not accepted and the curve is non-monotone with strong sign conflicts, so a single signed direction or absolute coordinate target is not justified from this evidence.
